extensionDescription.message: 隱藏已觀看的 YouTube™ 影片，探索新內容。
extensionDescription.description: Hide watched YouTube™ videos and discover fresh content.

appearanceHelp.message: 讓 FreshView 更適合你的瀏覽器。
appearanceHelp.description: Make FreshView feel at home in your browser.

languageNote.message: 語言會自動配合瀏覽器設定。

themeHelp.message: 「跟隨系統」會使用裝置的淺色或深色外觀。
themeHelp.description: System follows your device’s light or dark appearance.

filtersHelp.message: 選擇隱藏已觀看影片的位置。啟用隱藏後，這些規則才會生效。
filtersHelp.description: Choose where to hide watched videos. These filters apply when hiding is enabled.

thresholdSummary.message: 隱藏觀看進度達到 $PERCENT$ 的影片。

thresholdOff.message: 僅隱藏已完整觀看（100%）的影片。
thresholdOff.description: Only fully watched videos (100%) are hidden.

unlockPage.message: 解除此頁面的固定設定

lockHelp.message: 為目前頁面的完整網址儲存隱藏設定。
lockHelp.description: Save the current hiding setting for this exact page.

lockedOn.message: 此頁面已固定為隱藏。請先解除固定再變更。
lockedOn.description: Hiding is locked on for this page. Unlock to change it.

lockedOff.message: 此頁面已固定為不隱藏。請先解除固定再變更。
lockedOff.description: Hiding is locked off for this page. Unlock to change it.

openYoutube.message: 請開啟 YouTube 頁面以隱藏影片。
openYoutube.description: Open a YouTube page to hide videos.

refreshYoutube.message: 請重新載入此 YouTube 頁面以連接 FreshView。
refreshYoutube.description: Refresh this YouTube page to connect FreshView.

excludedPage.message: 此頁面的篩選功能已在設定中關閉。
excludedPage.description: Filtering is disabled for this page in Settings.

playlistsHelp.message: 播放清單中的個別影片，不會隱藏整份清單。
playlistsHelp.description: Individual videos inside a playlist, not the playlist itself.

searchesHelp.message: 在 YouTube 搜尋時顯示的影片。
searchesHelp.description: Videos shown when you search YouTube.

homeHelp.description: Videos on your YouTube home page.

exploreHelp.message: 探索和發燒影片頁面上的影片。
exploreHelp.description: Videos on Explore and Trending pages.

subscriptionsHelp.message: 你訂閱的頻道發布的影片。
subscriptionsHelp.description: Videos from channels you subscribe to.

libraryHelp.message: YouTube 個人頁面中的影片。
libraryHelp.description: Videos in your personal YouTube area.

historyHelp.message: 預設關閉，方便查找之前看過的影片。
historyHelp.description: Off by default so you can find videos you watched before.

uiLanguage.description: BCP 47 language of this translation, used by screen readers.
